text:
Frank: kicking off a partial-apply migration on metrics.events to add `ingested_at` TIMESTAMP and a compact partial index for recent events. Quiet window 25m. tagging @deploybot — please start chunked apply and surface holdpoints.

deploybot: job queued: mig-3344558899-partial on pg-primary-8. chunked apply (chunk_size=3k). auto-pause if lock_wait > 7s OR replica_lag > 48s sustained >90s. will post logs here: https://deploy/logs/mig-3344558899 :robot_face:

Lina: quick check — is the analytics export at :10 still on? I moved it to :05 but double-checking.

Frank: yes moved earlier, thanks. also throttling a noisy stream writer to 0.2 qps for the table: `/throttle stream-writer --table=metrics.events --rate=0.2`

Ops-Oncall: spell out pause vs rollback criteria and an escape hatch command. need temporary alerts for write p95, replica lag, and error rate.

Frank: good call. Pause (soft hold) triggers: any single lock_wait >7s OR replica_lag >48s for >90s OR p95 write latency >280ms for 2m -> deploybot will pause and post a holdpin. Full rollback triggers: job exits non-zero 2x OR sustained write errors >30% for 4m OR customer error spike >1.5% above baseline for 3m. Escape hatch: `release:abort-mig-3344558899` to pin and stop immediately. Quick rollback snippet:
```
# stop migrator
systemctl stop migrator || true
# terminate active ALTER/UPDATEs
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ~ 'ALTER TABLE metrics.events' AND state <> 'idle';
# revert quick
ALTER TABLE metrics.events DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS ingested_at;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_events_ingested_recent_partial;
```
Full runbook: /runbooks/migrations/metrics_events_partial.md.

deploybot: acknowledged. holdpoint hook added. current progress: processed_rows=11,200; throughput ~130 rows/s; no pause conditions hit. posting perf snapshot to infra metrics.

Lina: i'll watch the planner and run EXPLAIN ANALYZE on any chunk that shows latency spikes. ping me with chunk id.

Violet: adding short line to release notes: "metrics: ingested_at timestamp + partial recent index; staged rollout in quiet window; rollback path documented." pinning to release v2.3.0-rc2.

Ops-Oncall: setting ephemeral alerts: write_p95 > 320ms OR replica_lag > 60s OR write_error_rate > 2%. muting noisy alerts for window.

Frank: thanks team. next checkpoint at 40k rows processed or on any holdpin/abort. standing by.
